#mrsfisher.Eyes.Normal+mrsfisher.Mouth.Angry
Mrs. Fisher: What’s up with you, you look like ass.
You: I would like to smoke the fish joint please. 
Mrs. Fisher: I don’t think so buddy. There’s something seriously wrong with you right now. I can see it in your eyes.
You: Come on! You gave it to me so many times and now when I really need it you refuse? What’s wrong with you!
#mrsfisher.Face.Angry
Mrs. Fisher: If you want to act like a junkie you can fuck the right off. 
You: I act like a junkie? Wasn’t it you who said it was completely safe?!
Mrs. Fisher: And after you took it I told you you have no compatibility for it. 
Mrs. Fisher: Now that I see how bad it got I will never give it to you again.
You: What?! That’s unfair! You have no right to do it! 
Mrs. Fisher: Watch me. 
You: …
Mrs. Fisher: Was that enough for you? Now you can get the hell out of my beach.
You: Fine!
